subject.title: fix(cli): bound media input file reads with per-file and aggregate budget

question: Should capability CLI commands preserve acceptance of large existing `--file` inputs while adding bounded reads, or should OpenClaw adopt documented 100 MiB/500 MiB rejection limits?
rationale: The proposed fixed limits change established CLI behavior for existing users; the supplied evidence does not establish that these values are the intended public compatibility contract.

options.title: Preserve existing input compatibility
options.body: Use descriptor-bound bounded reading to prevent uncontrolled allocation without newly rejecting ordinary previously supported input sizes.

options.title: Adopt documented limits
options.body: Accept the 100 MiB per-file and 500 MiB aggregate policy only with explicit CLI/docs contract, upgrade rationale, and focused boundary coverage.

recommendation.title: Preserve existing input compatibility
recommendation.body: Use descriptor-bound bounded reading to prevent uncontrolled allocation without newly rejecting ordinary previously supported input sizes.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only concrete contributor connected to the supplied media-read implementation history; current-main ownership needs a separate history pass before assigning a stronger owner.
